# Error Codes

Source of truth: [shared/constants/errors.ts](../../shared/constants/errors.ts). Every error response is `{ "success": false, "error": { "code", "message", "details"? } }` and the HTTP status is **fixed per code** (below). Use these codes — never invent strings. Need a new code? Add it to `errors.ts` (team sign-off), run `npm run docs:build`.

## Generic

| Code | HTTP | Default message | Used by |
|---|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Request validation failed. | many (automatic) |
| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 | Resource not found. | staff.payrollPay |
| `INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION` | 409 | This status change is not allowed. | memberships.changePlan, memberships.cancel, bookings.cancel, bookings.complete, social.cancel, shop.orderStatus, shop.orderCancel, bar.orderCancel, kitchen.status, enquiries.update, enquiries.followUp, enquiries.quoteUpdate, invoices.send, invoices.void, staff.leaveDecide, staff.leaveCancel, staff.payrollPay |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Unexpected server error. | many (automatic) |

## Conventions

- `details` is optional structured context, e.g. `BOOKING_CONFLICT.details = { court_id, start_at }`, `DAILY_BOOKING_LIMIT.details = { plays_used_today, plays_allowed_per_day, date }`, `OUT_OF_STOCK.details.items = [{ product_id, requested, available }]`, `INVALID_STATUS_TRANSITION.details = { from, to, allowed }`, `VALIDATION_ERROR.details.fields = { field: message }`.
- DB-level violations are mapped, not leaked: SQLSTATE `23P01` (exclusion) → `BOOKING_CONFLICT`; `23514` on `products.stock_quantity` → `OUT_OF_STOCK`; `23505` on `users_email_key` → `EMAIL_TAKEN`; `23505` on `memberships_one_active_per_member` → `MEMBERSHIP_ALREADY_ACTIVE`; any unmapped error → `INTERNAL_ERROR` (log server-side, return a generic message).
- Messages are for humans and may be shown in the UI; **logic must branch on `code`**, never on `message`.
